confirm.check-in: Confirm that the guest has arrived. You can optionally assign a room number.
confirm.check-out: Confirm that the guest has completed their stay and is ready to check out.
confirm.mark-paid: Only confirm after you have actually received the full payment at the hotel. This records offline collection; it does not charge the guest online.
confirm.cancel: Cancel this booking and release its room inventory. Refunds are handled separately under the cancellation policy. Please provide a reason.
confirm.no-show: Confirm that the guest did not arrive. The server will apply the booking's no-show policy. This is not a fee waiver.
